title: Symmetry and critical points of second Neumann eigenfunctions on isosceles trapezoids and kites
summary: We classify the symmetry and multiplicity of the second Neumann eigenvalue on isosceles trapezoids and kites as the height varies. Precisely, away from a unique transition height, the second Neumann eigenvalue is simple, and its eigenfunction is either symmetric or antisymmetric. At a transition height, it has multiplicity two, with one symmetric and one antisymmetric basis eigenfunction.
